notes.title: Sudoku Killer new release date - October 19
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/861270/Sudoku_Killer/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30909774/efd5a4989eedecffd57a28820e58e569ac70d736.png[/img][/url]

Greetings :)

We decided to postpone Sudoku Killer for a few weeks, it'll be available on [h1]Friday, [b]October 19[/b], wishlist to stay updated![/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/861270/Sudoku_Killer/

This will be the hardest Sudoku of all our Sudoku series, so prepare yourself. [b]100[/b] killer levels will bring you hours of brain exercises. Wish you all good luck and have a great time playing our new game.

[h1]Reviews are really important for us[/h1]
Positive. Negative. Whatever. We encourage you to write any thoughts you have about our games, you will make them better. Even few words will be enough. This is especially critical during launch week, so do not hesitate!

[h1]Sudoku Bundle[/h1]
Sudoku Killer from launch date will be a part of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6448/Sudoku_Universe_Bundle/]Sudoku Bundle[/url] (35% OFF), so all owners of Sudoku Universe or Jigsaw will be able to get it really cheap. Or it's just good chance to buy all of them if you haven't played any. They are really good :)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6448/Sudoku_Universe_Bundle/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32988905/5b060570d0a06a1d2ab414f0e39895e7ce13b4d8.png[/img][/url]

Thanks for your attention and support.

[i]Your best,
Nestor from Konstructors[/i]
